job.title: Growth Engineer
job.description:
Growth Engineer
Fully Remote (Australia OR NZ Based)
  
Build, experiment and innovate. An opportunity to combine software engineering, AI and growth marketing to drive real commercial impact.
  
The Opportunity
  
They're an innovative Australian fintech business on a mission to help people regain control of their finances, leveraging technology, automation and smarter digital solutions to make financial wellbeing more accessible.
  
With a strong focus on innovation and digital growth, the business is continuing to invest in emerging technologies, AI and new ways of reaching and engaging customers.
  
They're now looking for a Growth Engineer to join their marketing team, bringing together the worlds of software engineering, artificial intelligence and customer acquisition.
This isn't your typical software engineering role.
  
You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of technical growth initiatives, from building AI-powered organic acquisition strategies and launching new digital experiences to integrating marketing platforms and automating processes.
  
It's an opportunity for a developer who enjoys thinking commercially, experimenting with new ideas and seeing the direct impact of what they build.
  
Why This Role?
  • The intersection of engineering and growth: Combine your technical expertise with commercial thinking, building solutions that directly influence customer acquisition and business growth.
  • AI at the forefront: Leverage AI and emerging technologies to accelerate development, automate processes and explore new approaches to organic growth.
  • Genuine ownership and autonomy: Take ideas from concept through to execution, with the freedom to experiment, challenge existing approaches and drive meaningful outcomes.
  • Variety and innovation: Work across everything from SEO and AI discovery to marketing technology integrations, automation and rapid product experimentation.
  • Build, test and iterate: Launch new landing pages, digital experiences and growth initiatives quickly, using data and experimentation to continuously improve results.
  • Visible commercial impact: See the direct results of your work, with the opportunity to influence how the business attracts, engages and converts customers.
  
The Role
  
Working closely with the marketing and growth team, you'll play a key role in developing and delivering technical initiatives that support customer acquisition and organic growth.
  
You'll be responsible for building and deploying landing pages at scale, leveraging AI to improve development efficiency and creating the technical foundations that enable smarter, more effective marketing.
  
Beyond organic growth, you'll work on integrating internal systems with digital marketing platforms, building automated workflows and connecting customer data with advertising and analytics technologies.
  
You'll also have the opportunity to experiment with new brands, domains and digital concepts, rapidly developing and testing solutions to validate market opportunities.
  
It's a role that offers the freedom to build, experiment and solve interesting problems, without being confined to traditional software development.
  
We're looking for a mix of the following:
  • Software engineering experience
  • Experience building and deploying web applications, landing pages or digital platforms.
  • An understanding of SEO, organic growth and how technology can be leveraged to drive customer acquisition.
  • Experience designing and building integrations across APIs, internal systems, databases and third-party platforms.
  • Exposure to marketing technology, digital advertising platforms or customer data integrations.
  • Experience using AI tools and automation to improve development productivity and accelerate delivery.
  • An understanding of event tracking, analytics and measuring the performance of digital initiatives.
  • A commercial mindset, with the ability to translate business and marketing objectives into technical solutions.
  • A proactive, curious approach and the ability to thrive in an environment that encourages experimentation and innovation.
  
Experience with mobile attribution platforms such as AppsFlyer, AI-driven SEO initiatives or growth experimentation would be highly regarded.
  
More important than ticking every technical box is your ability to think beyond traditional development, identify opportunities and use technology to create meaningful commercial outcomes.
  
Next Steps
For more information and/or to be considered for this role, please apply now.

Shape the technology landscape of a rapidly scaling Australian business. Genuine autonomy, greenfield opportunities and the freedom to make an impact.

We're partnering with one of Australia's fastest-growing businesses, an ambitious, technology-driven organisation that has experienced extraordinary growth in recent years.
  
Operating within a traditionally established industry, this business is anything but traditional in its approach. Innovation is embedded in its culture, with significant investment in emerging technologies, AI and digital transformation to challenge conventional ways of working.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Our client is one of Australia's largest hospitality groups, operating a national portfolio of pubs, bars and event venues.
The business has grown largely through acquisition. Each venue is run with a local-first approach, tailored to its community rather than following a single template.
About the role
The business needs a demand forecasting model for the venues it has acquired in the last 12 months. You will own that build, from approach through to production.
The core challenge is limited history. These venues have only a short trading record in the company's systems, and earlier data may sit in different point-of-sale systems or be incomplete. You will need to forecast reliably by drawing on patterns from comparable venues across the wider network, then improve the model as each site's own data builds up.
Your forecasts will feed directly into how venues roster staff, order stock and plan trading.
Key responsibilities
  • Design and build a demand forecasting model for recently acquired venues, covering revenue, covers and product demand at daily and intraday levels
  • Solve the cold-start problem by using data from comparable venues, hierarchical approaches and pre-trained time series models where they help
  • Bring in external drivers such as weather, public holidays, school holidays, local events, sport and promotions
  • Clean, align and integrate venue data from different point-of-sale and operational systems
  • Deploy the model to production with automated retraining, monitoring and drift detection
  • Set clear accuracy measures and report performance by venue, region and venue type
  • Work with operations, finance and venue managers so forecasts are understood, trusted and used
  • Document the approach so the model can be maintained and extended to future acquisitions
Essential skills and experience
  • 5+ years in data science, with demand or sales forecasting models built and run in production
  • Strong Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with forecasting and ML methods such as LightGBM, XGBoost, Prophet or ARIMA
  • Experience forecasting with sparse, short or patchy history, such as new stores or sites
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or Databricks)
  • Ability to explain model outputs and limitations to non-technical stakeholders
  • Tertiary qualification in data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or a related field
Desirable skills
  • Hospitality, retail, QSR or other multi-site business experience
  • Hierarchical forecasting (for example network, region, venue, product)
  • Experience with foundation time series models such as Chronos or TimeGPT
  • Databricks, PySpark and MLflow
  • Weather and event-driven demand modelling
  • Promotional uplift or causal impact analysis

job.title: Embedded Software Developer
job.description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer, Medical Devices Location: Melbourne (South-East suburbs), hybrid
Type: Contractor, full-time
About the company An established Australian product development and engineering firm with more than 20 years of experience bringing complex technology to market. The team builds products for medical, industrial and defence clients in regulated environments where safety and reliability are critical.
Their medical work covers Class II and Class III devices, including advanced cardiovascular technology, medical robotics and AI-enabled treatment platforms. You’ll work with electronics, mechanical, software, human factors and regulatory specialists on products that directly affect patient outcomes.
The role A senior, hands-on role designing and building embedded software for life-critical medical devices, from hardware bring-up through to the user interface. You’ll shape software architecture, set engineering standards and mentor others, while staying close to the code.
What you’ll do
  • Architect and develop embedded software in modern C/C++ across microcontroller, RTOS and embedded Linux platforms
  • Build device user interfaces and HMIs for touchscreen medical products
  • Design layered, reusable software platforms with clean hardware abstraction
  • Lead board bring-up and hardware/software integration with electronics engineers
  • Develop communication interfaces (BLE, Wi-Fi, TCP/IP, serial, CAN, USB)
  • Deliver under a formal medical software lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, risk analysis and verification
  • Set up and improve CI/CD, static analysis and automated testing
  • Lead design and code reviews and mentor engineers
  • Work directly with clients to shape requirements and present technical progress
What you’ll bring
  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Computer or Mechatronics Engineering (or similar)
  • 8+ years of commercial embedded software development in C and modern C++ (C++14/17)
  • Delivery of software for regulated medical devices under IEC 62304 and ISO 13485
  • Experience with RTOS (e.g. FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX) and embedded Linux
  • Embedded UI development with frameworks such as Qt/QML, LVGL or similar
  • Strong software architecture skills, including design patterns and platform abstraction
  • Comfort with schematics, debuggers and lab tools during bring-up
  • Experience leading or mentoring engineers in a small, high-ownership team
Highly regarded
  • Safety-critical experience beyond medical (e.g. IEC 61508, aerospace, ATM, automotive)
  • ISO 14971 risk management and medical device cybersecurity
  • CI/CD with Docker and GitHub Actions, plus static analysis (PC-lint, cppcheck) and TDD
  • Simulation, automated UI or screenshot regression testing
  • Practical use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools in development
  • Python for test automation and tooling
Why apply
  • Build Class II and III devices that directly affect patient lives
  • Variety across clients, from start-ups to global medtech
  • Influence architecture and engineering practice, not just deliver tickets
  • Collaborative, engineering-led culture
  • Hybrid working in a growing team

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join a team responsible for the reliability, performance and scalability of a large-scale SaaS platform used by organisations across Australia and internationally.

This is a hands-on role combining cloud infrastructure, DevOps, automation and software engineering. You'll play a key part in keeping the platform running smoothly, improving existing systems and introducing new technologies and processes to make things more efficient.

Working closely with engineering and product teams, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of technical challenges, reduce manual work through automation and contribute to the ongoing development of a critical platform.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Maintaining and improving the reliability, availability, performance and security of SaaS platforms.
  • Developing automation and writing code to reduce manual tasks and improve operational efficiency.
  • Managing and optimising cloud infrastructure and serverless services within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Building, maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
  • Troubleshooting technical issues and contributing to incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Supporting platform scalability, capacity planning and disaster recovery.
  • Working with engineering teams to understand technical requirements and deliver practical solutions.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve platform performance, infrastructure and engineering practices.
What We're Looking For
  • Experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Engineering or Platform Engineering.
  • An understanding of cloud infrastructure and serverless technologies, ideally within Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with Linux operating systems and troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to Docker and containerisation technologies.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and scripting using Bash, Python or similar languages.
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI or Travis CI.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience working with MySQL databases and basic SQL.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Work on a SaaS platform supporting large organisations nationally and internationally.
  • Gain exposure to Google Cloud technologies and modern serverless architecture.
  • Access company-supported Google Cloud training and certifications to support your professional development.
